summary: Verified NOEMA Discovery artifact and triaged fresh scholarly/public research. Staged three candidate-only records: Les Rois 2 taxonomic reassessment to H. sapiens, new direct radiocarbon/taphonomic chronology for three Granada Neolithic cannibalism assemblages, and aDNA/paleopathology of an exceptional Semigallian multiple burial. No historical relationship, approved claim, or evidence promotion was made.
research_note: Material pressures: taxonomic uncertainty can be revised without implying population-history relationships; behavioral labels such as cannibalism require episode-level chronology and context; co-burial can mix close kin and unrelated individuals; violent context does not identify attackers or establish a raid.
